open_points.subject: M18 FlowActivation / activate flow action
open_points.text: "A flow's active version is the one recorded last (K-17); a new activation replaces the previous one at once"
open_points.question: If the requested flow version is already the active version, does the kernel create a new FlowActivation record or return the existing active one unchanged?
options: Create a new FlowActivation record every successful activate request, even when version is already active
Treat activate of already-active version as idempotent and return existing activation without writing a new record
open_points.default_guess: Treat as idempotent and return existing activation without a new record

open_points.subject: M24 EffectApproval / approve or refuse an effect action
open_points.text: "An approved, unused approval whose `request_digest` no longer matches the request about to be sent stays `approved` and unused ... the kernel then ... requests a new approval"
open_points.question: Can multiple approvals for the same `run_id`+`node_id`+`map_index` coexist in `requested`/`approved` states, and if so, how is the owner-facing decision target selected?
options: Allow only one live approval request per waiting node element; new request is blocked until prior one is decided/used
Allow multiple approvals to coexist; the kernel always uses the one whose `request_digest` matches the send attempt
open_points.default_guess: Allow coexistence and select by matching `request_digest`

open_points.subject: M19 Run.waiting
open_points.question: When a run reaches a final status (`succeeded`/`failed`/`refused`/`cancelled`), must `waiting` be cleared, or can final runs retain waiting points as last-known state?
options: `waiting` is current-only and is emptied when run becomes final
`waiting` may remain on final runs as historical snapshot
open_points.default_guess: `waiting` is current-only and is cleared on finalization
